content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a silent data loss issue during the merging of segments in Lucene, specifically when binary fields were truncated to 0 bytes. This occurred when segments being merged had non-congruent field numbers for the same field name, which was introduced in a previous change (LUCENE-1219). The patch addresses this by ensuring that the binary length is correctly set when reading binary fields, preventing the truncation of data during the merge process.
